name: IBY_APPLICABLE_PMT_MTHDS_
description: IBY_APPLICABLE_PMT_MTHDS stores the payment method applicability information for company policy-based factors. The factors include First Party Legal Entity, First Party Organization, Payment Processing Transaction Type, Transaction is Foreign Currency or Not, Cross-Border Transaction or Not, and Payment Amount. Payment method applicability determines which payment method applies under given conditions. It is used to narrow the list of possible payment methods when a user or application is assigning a payment method to a document payable. This table is shared by funds capture and fund disbursement flows.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FLOW
columns.description: Specifies funds capture or disbursement flow.  Values taken from lookup: IBY_PAYMENT_FLOW

columns.name: APPLICABLE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Applicable type. Each type corresponds to one factor in determining the applicability of a payment method. Lookup values of IBY_PMT_MTHD_USAGE_RULE_TYPES lookup type

columns.name: APPLICABLE_VALUE_FROM
columns.description: From value of the applicability type. Used for the payment amount applicability only

columns.name: APPLICABLE_VALUE_TO
columns.description: To value of the applicability type

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application Identifier of the calling product

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
